description: This file implements wrapper classes and resource management for Metal's MTLTexture and MTLBuffer within the ANGLE project, including texture creation, synchronization, and buffer handling.

classes.name: Resource
classes.description: Base class for GPU resources, managing usage references and synchronization.

classes.name: Texture
classes.description: Wrapper for Metal textures, supporting creation, views, and content synchronization.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: Wrapper for Metal buffers, supporting creation, mapping, and resizing.

methods.name: GetMipSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of a mipmap level based on base size and level.

methods.name: SetTextureSwizzle
methods.description: Configures texture swizzle channels if supported and enabled.

methods.name: Resource::isBeingUsedByGPU
methods.description: Checks if resource is currently used by GPU.

methods.name: Resource::setUsedByCommandBufferWithQueueSerial
methods.description: Marks resource as used by a command buffer with a specific serial.

methods.name: Texture::Make2DTexture
methods.description: Creates a 2D Metal texture with specified parameters.

methods.name: Texture::MakeCubeTexture
methods.description: Creates a cube Metal texture with specified parameters.

methods.name: Texture::MakeFromMetal
methods.description: Creates a Texture wrapper from an existing Metal texture.

methods.name: Texture::syncContent
methods.description: Synchronizes GPU and CPU content of the texture.

methods.name: Texture::replaceRegion
methods.description: Replaces a region of the texture with provided data.

methods.name: Texture::getBytes
methods.description: Reads bytes from a texture region.

methods.name: Buffer::MakeBuffer
methods.description: Creates a buffer wrapper with specified size and data.

methods.name: Buffer::reset
methods.description: Resets the buffer with new size and data.

methods.name: Buffer::map
methods.description: Maps buffer contents for CPU access.

methods.name: Buffer::unmap
methods.description: Unmaps the buffer after CPU access.

calls: [get() replaceRegion:region mipmapLevel:mipmapLevel slice:slice withBytes:data bytesPerRow:bytesPerRow bytesPerImage:0]
